myths.claim: More inches always means a better picture
myths.confirm: You are right that size is the first thing to get right.
myths.correct: At 8 feet, 55 inch is the sweet spot. Beyond that you move your head instead of watching.

myths.claim: QLED and OLED are the same thing
myths.confirm: Both are premium panels, so the confusion is fair.
myths.correct: QLED is a bright LED panel. OLED switches each pixel off for true black, and costs more.
